title: Toys (Quality Control) Order, 2020
notes: Mandates that all non-electric and electric toys manufactured, imported, or sold in India must conform to relevant Indian Standards (IS 9873 Parts 1, 2, 3 and IS 15644) and bear the Standard ISI Mark under Scheme-I of Schedule-II of the BIS (Conformity Assessment) Regulations 2018. Goods manufactured by registered artisans and weavers are subject to special MSME provisions.

standards.exemption_notes: Mandatory for physical and mechanical properties
Mandatory for toxic heavy metal migration

amendments.summary: Extended original enforcement date from 01-09-2020 to 01-01-2021 to allow manufacturers and testing laboratories to upgrade capacity.

title: Solar Photovoltaics, Systems, Devices and Components Goods (Requirements for Compulsory Registration) Order, 2017
issuing_ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
notes: Mandates compulsory registration under Scheme-II (CRS) with BIS for crystalline silicon terrestrial PV modules, thin-film modules, and power converters/inverters. Manufacturers must obtain test reports from accredited BIS labs.

standards.exemption_notes: Mandatory for crystalline silicon terrestrial PV modules

amendments.amendment_number: MNRE Solar PV Order Enforcement Extension Notice
amendments.summary: Provided self-certification window while lab testing capacity was ramped up across government laboratories.

title: Electrical Appliances for Household and Similar Purposes (Quality Control) Order, 2023
notes: Mandates compulsory conformity to IS 302 series and standard mark (ISI Mark under Scheme-I) for stationary storage water heaters, electric irons, room heaters, immersion water heaters, and electric stoves.

amendments.summary: Staggered compliance dates for micro enterprises (12 months extension) and small enterprises (6 months extension) to facilitate BIS licensing.

title: Steel and Steel Products (Quality Control) Order, 2020
notes: Mandates Scheme-I ISI Mark certification for high-strength deformed bars (TMT bars IS 1786) and structural steel (IS 2062). Prohibits manufacture, sale, or import without licence.

title: Two-Wheeler Protective Helmets (Quality Control) Order, 2020
issuing_ministry: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH)
notes: Mandates that all helmets for riders of two-wheeled motor vehicles must conform to IS 4151: 2015 and bear the Standard ISI Mark under Scheme-I. Non-certified helmets cannot be manufactured, stocked, or sold.

standards.exemption_notes: Mandatory for all two-wheeler helmets in India

title: Electronics and Information Technology Goods (Requirement of Compulsory Registration) Order, Phase-IV
issuing_ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
notes: Mandates Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS) under Scheme-II for secondary cells, lithium battery packs, power banks, and servers under IS 16046 and IS 13252.

standards.exemption_notes: Lithium battery cells and power banks
